name: button
title: Button
description: The action control: `variant` sets its weight, `loading` swaps the icon for a spinner and disables it while it runs. Copy: the verb the reader is about to perform, with its object when the screen has more than one — "Send invoice", not "Submit", never "OK". The label is a promise about what happens next.
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Button.json
